notes.title: Balance patch and reduced price
notes.content:
We have made various updates to improve game balance - this included changes of resource generation, unit attributes, and price/strength of skills (details below). This should bring the chances to win for each faction even closer. We continue to keep an eye for those that under/overperform. 


[b]Balance updates[/b]

[i]Changes (resource):[/i]
Corrupted resource generation  - Damage dealt/8, Damage received/16
Maharama resource generation - Death of allied unit reduces resource by 10

[i]Changes (skills):[/i]
No Escape - new resource price 25 
Armor of faith - new resource price 25
Mirrored Doom - new resource price 15
Afterimage - new action points price 4
Barrier - added unlimited range
Shadow orb - new action points price 5
Echo - new action points price 3, resource price 20
Dark Sanctuary - new action points price 4, resource price 20
Reaper's Breath - new action points price 5, resource price 25
Empty Gaze - new resource price 25
End Justifies Means - new resource price 15
Devour - new action points price 4, resource price 20
Ashes To Ashes - new action points price 2, resource price 15
Freezing Grasp - new action points price 2, resource price 20
Iceball - new action points price 3, resource price 25
Raw Power - new action points price 4, resource price 30
Survival Instincts - new resource price 10
Copycat - new action points price 3, range 4
Parasite - new action points price 2, resource price 15, range 3
Power Supply - new action points price 3
Blood Must Flow - new resource price 25

Entangle - new resource price 10

Slippery Thought - new resource price 10

Electrocute - increased damage to 120%

[i]Changes (attributes):[/i]

notes.title: ToC full release on 6.3.2022
notes.content:
Full release of the Theater of Carnage is scheduled for Sunday 6th of March 2022. It is time to sharpen weapons and wit. All 4 factions are refined, each with their own unique flavor. And their champions are ready to enter the fray under your command.

notes.title: Full Release of ToC is just around the corner
notes.content:
We are delighted to share that Theater Of Carnage is almost finished! All the factions and characters are completed. Now we are just working on final tune up and polishing.

More information about release date will be coming soon.

notes.title: De re militari
notes.content:
The first major update that brings new singleplayer gameplay options. You can now hone you skills by challenging AI in a skrimish mode with the standard set of rules. Additionally, we have prepared set of 15 special scenarios, that players can challenge and compete for the best time. In this mode game starts with pre-determined situation on the battlefield and player needs to find a way to solve it and win. 

[previewyoutube=FV1pl28kmbg;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Man vs Machine
notes.content:
Hello,
 
Just a quick update of improvements that we are currently working on. We are steadily progressing in our efforts to add some singleplayer content to the Theater of Carnage. This will first include option to test your skills against AI in the standard game setting. We believe it will be quite a challenge to beat. Afterwards we also plan to include pre-defined challenge scenarios. 

You can see here a short example of how the AI is trained. UI and unit movement are disabled in the training videos, and game speed is quite faster than usual. 

[previewyoutube=GvSonCJv0Is;full][/previewyoutube]
